description: Validation Rule 6: "Skipped or not-yet-executed graders [...] MUST be represented with score: null and passed: false. score: null means 'not verified'". A GraderResult with score: null and passed: true claims a verdict the grader never produced. The raw JSON Schema types score and passed independently and does not encode this cross-field rule, so it accepts this document; the reference validators reject it (NULL_SCORE_PASSED), the same way they enforce other cross-field rules such as SELF_PARENT and DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT. A conformance implementation MUST perform this check itself. Derived from a real case: frontieror-openeval-adapter emitted its unbounded staged_qte grader as score: null with passed: stage_id == 2.
